speaker: john_heminges
text: Ten shillings. Sit, and do not make me say the figure twice for the pleasure of the echo.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Ten. Write it received. I was not at the comedy. I am not asking the book to pretend I was.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Two Gentlemen, at two. An old comedy. The book will say you were at home, because you were at home. The share does not require your attendance at a play that was cast without you.

speaker: margery_pell
text: A better stair than Tuesday. I am not putting a sermon on it. Your ten is the share, Master Shakespeare, and not the box at my feet.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Ten shillings, and a city that starts at a thumb. I say the roads. In the country they have not had this month shouted through their markets. I could be new. You have heard me say so. I am saying so again while the cloth is still on the table.

speaker: james_burbage
text: I want my doors open. A wagon is a hole in a week. No one is handing me that hole tonight, and I can hear John's Monday before he has said it.

speaker: george_bryan
text: The paper is two days old. A marshal's name is on it. Players on a road are a Monday question. They are not a decoration for a reckoning that has already gone well.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Thou wert writing, Will. Tell me it was not another king. I have just learned to like an empty arm.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Not a king. A street. Thou shalt have none of it tonight, and Kemp shall have none of it either. It is not a part. It is a morning.

speaker: will_kemp
text: A street is a start, and streets are where a man is useful. You might remember usefulness, Will. Ten shillings is a fine fee for forgetting your friends until Monday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I remember. Another day. Not over this cloth, and not with a play that has no clown in it yet because it has no second page.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The roads stay open as a question. Monday. I am not dividing a company on a Saturday night over oats I have not priced.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Monday, then. I am not shutting my doors because a paper dislikes a crowd. I am also not getting a vote tonight. I know the difference. I am old.

speaker: george_bryan
text: No one is shutting them tonight. I am saying we do not answer the paper by leaving. Not this hour. Monday, if John wants Monday. I will be there, and I will not be hurried by a boot.

speaker: will_kemp
text: I have been patient since Sunday night, and patience is not my famous quality. Monday. I will come with my boots, and you may tell me to take them off. I will even listen.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Tell him on Monday, John. Do not use my ten shillings as the text.

speaker: john_heminges
text: The text is ten shillings, received. There is no new total on this sheet. I will not make one up to please a tidy mind, or to frighten a man who has not counted his box.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Empty of a total, and full of a supper I mean to eat. Are we done being a council? Thou canst go back to thy street, Will, if the street will have thee.

speaker: margery_pell
text: You are done being a council when I have heard the ten and not a plan. I have heard the ten. I have not heard a plan. Keep it so till Monday, and I will think well of you, which is rare and should be enjoyed.

speaker: george_bryan
text: Monday. I will not say it a third time if John will say it once more and have done.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Once more, for George. Monday. I am not promising any man a road tonight. Will, your ten is on the cloth.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Received. I am going home by Bishopsgate Street. I said the road last night to nobody. I am saying the road now, and not the reason.

speaker: richard_burbage
text: Walk it, then. Thou hast ink on thee. Try not to spend the ten on a better horn before supper. Twopence is enough ink for a man who has already written his morning.

speaker: will_kemp
text: Spend it on boots if you like. Monday will want them, or it will not. I enjoy a question I can wear.

speaker: james_burbage
text: Out. My house has heard enough of roads for one night. The doors are as I left them. Let them stay.

speaker: john_heminges
text: Good night. Ten shillings, and the question left where we found it.
